{"metadata":{"description":"Context undo/redo plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): roll the model context back to the last completed step and restore it again.","id":"gh:1333182502","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-undo","slug":"LingLambda/dsh-undo","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Context undo/redo plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): roll the model context back to the last complet"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ed step and restore it again."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-undo"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> [!WARNING]
> **Forward-looking preview: this release is not usable with any currently published De"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"epSeek Harness version.** It depends on unreleased Harness support for durable `surface/rewind` / `s"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"urface/restore` events and the `conversation.chat.user-actions` WebUI slot. Installing it today will"},{"id":"p4s4","text":" make `/undo` fail closed with an upgrade message. Publish this package only to preview and coordina"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"te the future integration; do not present it as production-ready until the matching Harness release "},{"id":"p4s6","text":"exists. look for <https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/467/>"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Durable, multi-level undo/redo for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`). It rewinds model context by real user t"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"urn and restores workspace files changed by tools in that turn."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The commands are handled locally and are never sent to the model:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **`/undo`** rewinds the latest visible real user message and every surface message after it.
- **`"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"/undo <user-seq>`** rewinds from a specific visible user message, including all later turns.
- **`/r"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"edo`** restores the latest active rewind. Repeated undo and redo operations use LIFO order."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The WebUI client contributes an undo action to finalized real-user message bubbles. The action invok"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"es `/undo <user-seq>`; the Host validates that the addressed message is still a legal rewind target."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## How It Works"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Harness sessions remain append-only. Undo appends a dedicated `surface/rewind` control event for the"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" exact current surface suffix; redo appends `surface/restore` for the newest active rewind. The orig"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"inal message nodes, message IDs, tool-call correlations, and log events are retained. Session replay"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" reconstructs the same visible surface and redo stack after restart."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Before and after each top-level tool execution, the plugin records a workspace tree using an isolate"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"d hidden Git directory under `~/.dsh/dsh-undo/snapshots/`. It does not create commits, switch branch"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"es, or modify the repository's own Git index. Undo restores only files touched by tools in the selec"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ted user turns; redo restores the pre-undo tree. Patch and redo metadata are stored per session so f"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"ile redo can survive a Host restart."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Workspace tracking includes tracked files and untracked files up to 2 MiB. Files ignored by the repo"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"sitory and larger untracked files are left untouched. A small two-phase journal reconciles interrupt"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ed file operations against the durable active-rewind stack after restart. If the session has no Git "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"workspace, context undo/redo still works and the command reports that file restoration is unavailabl"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"rkspace, context undo/redo still works and the command reports that file restoration is unavailable."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Background jobs returned by top-level tools are associated with their user turn. Undo requests termi"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"nation for jobs started in the removed turns. Redo restores context and files but cannot restart ter"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"arted in the removed turns. Redo restores context and files but cannot restart terminated processes."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"This plugin requires a Harness version that supports:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- Durable `surface/rewind` and `surface/restore` session events.
- The `conversation.chat.user-actio"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ns` client slot for the WebUI action."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Older Harness releases fail closed: `/undo` reports that a compatible Harness upgrade is required in"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"stead of writing replacement assistant messages or copying transcript events."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Limits"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- File restoration is limited to the detected Git workspace. It never restores files outside that ro"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ot.
- Network requests, database writes, remote API calls, already-exited processes, and other exter"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"nal effects cannot be undone.
- Background jobs started through nested tool dispatches or child agen"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ts may not be associated with the root user turn.
- Undo signals recorded top-level background jobs "},{"id":"p19s5","text":"but does not wait indefinitely for process exit.
- New ordinary surface output invalidates active re"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"do history according to Harness surface semantics."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The package is a dsh bundle. `package.json` points `dsh.bundle` to `cordis.patch.yml`, which activat"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"es the Host plugin, and exposes a WebUI Client bundle."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"From npm:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"From git (the `prepare` script builds `lib/` during installation; authorize the build in the profile"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"'s `pnpm-workspace.yaml` first):"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"For local development against a Harness checkout, load the Host source with an overlay:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Use `/undo` for the latest user turn, the action on an older user bubble to rewind from that point, "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"and `/redo` to restore the most recent rewind."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Develop"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
